left_out: raw sub, neg and abs: a per-case loss that can be negative is unbounded below and breaks training_data.hard_example_weight, sqrt, log1p and pow (measured)
raw exp: non-finite on ordinary TRAIN-scale terms (measured); expm1 with a capped argument is admitted instead
reductions across cases: the per-case loss stays per case, so case weights, curricula and microbatches keep their meaning
constant leaves, conditionals, indexing and any operation outside this list
terms reading anything but TRAIN outputs, TRAIN targets and the output weights: no reference solver, no labels beyond TRAIN, no evaluation material
per-case weights chosen by final labels (inference.final_label_selection stays excluded)
the pytorch backend and the fno and knn families: their trainers do not read an expression
any change to the score, the exam, the evaluation or the disclosure rule

reductions.max_t: time sort to case sort: the maximum over time, summed over the trajectories named by over
reductions.mean_t: time sort to case sort: the mean over time, summed over the trajectories named by over

bounds.reconstruction: Carbon recompiles the expression from its canonical bytes against this operation set's digest (loss_expressions.from_bytes) and evaluates it with Carbon's own code inside Carbon's JAX trainer; nothing the strategy supplies is executed
bounds.sorts: every node is case-sorted (one value per case) or time-sorted (one value per case and time, evaluated per trajectory); elementwise operations take arguments of one sort; mean_t and max_t turn a time-sorted argument into a case-sorted value; the expression itself is case-sorted

case.sq_error: sum over outputs of the output-weighted squared error
case.sq_error_capacity: the capacity outputs' share of sq_error
case.sq_error_plating: the plating-margin output's share of sq_error
case.sq_error_temperature: the temperature outputs' share of sq_error
case.sq_error_voltage: the voltage outputs' share of sq_error
case.target_energy: sum over outputs of the output-weighted squared target
case.target_energy_capacity: the capacity outputs' share of target_energy
case.target_energy_plating: the plating-margin output's share of target_energy
case.target_energy_temperature: the temperature outputs' share of target_energy
case.target_energy_voltage: the voltage outputs' share of target_energy
case.traj_d1: squared first time-difference of the trajectory error
case.traj_d2: squared second time-difference of the trajectory error
case.traj_ramp_early: trajectory squared error under the 2-to-0 time ramp
case.traj_ramp_late: trajectory squared error under the 0-to-2 time ramp

time.err_sq_t: the squared normalized trajectory error at each time
time.time_rev_t: the time coordinate from 1 at the start to 0 at the end
time.time_t: the time coordinate from 0 at the start to 1 at the end

widened.summary: The per-case training loss as a bounded, declarative expression over battery's registered per-case and per-time loss terms, in place of the fixed objective menu. Carbon validates, canonicalizes and pins it, and builds the loss with its own code.
